packages.description: Hover Mode - Pro Tools-style Split / Trim at the mouse or edit cursor
about: Pro Tools-style editing that follows the mouse (Hover Mode on) or the edit cursor (Hover Mode off).
- Split: split items at the selection, edit cursor or mouse
- Trim Left / Right: trim or extend the item edge to the cursor, keeping fades
